contracts: Section 1: truck-certified/src/certified_map.rs (NEW). MapRefusal (exactly three named cases + tag(): ParameterizationDegenerate / EnclosureUnavailable / DomainNotCompact, per plan §2 class 1); CertifiedRegionRank<B> (margin + region box, accessors only); CertifiedCurveMap / CertifiedSurfaceMap (tau + declared domain + piece/patch table; constructed only through admit_curve / admit_surface). Admission: admit_curve / admit_surface decompose via the landed bezier_decomposition (curve) or the in-module row-wise-then-column-wise tensor cut (surface, D-map), certify the rank margin over the WHOLE domain against the declared PositiveFinite tau, and refuse ParameterizationDegenerate when the margin lower bound is <= tau. Per-region remedy: admit_curve_region / admit_surface_region certify a compact subbox of an admitted map against the stored tau and return a CertifiedRegionRank. Oracle: CertifiedCurveMap::enclosure/rank_margin, CertifiedSurfaceMap::enclosure/rank_margin, all returning Result with the 1:1 hull refusal mapping (HullRefusal::EnclosureUnavailable -> EnclosureUnavailable; DomainNotCompact -> DomainNotCompact, additionally for regions outside the declared domain). Enclosures are per-piece hulls over the piece-mapped subbox combined conservatively (component-wise min/max; the rank margin is the minimum of per-piece margins). D2 named compositions only: curve margin = hulls of the three source-parameter first-derivative coefficient vectors + the component rule (d_i = 0 if the enclosure contains 0 else distance from 0 to the nearer endpoint; sum of outward-rounded squares); surface margin = hulls of the six S_u/S_v patches + the three fixed interval cross-product expressions + the same component rule. H-1 discipline: no unwrap/expect/panic and no module-level allow.
Section 2: lib.rs, exactly one line (`pub mod certified_map;` beside `pub mod hull;`). Nothing else changed.

Section 3: truck-certified/tests/certified_map_conformance.rs (NEW), the 10 load-bearing tests, all named exactly as listed: curve_map_admission_certifies_rank_above_tau (line curve, 2 pieces of width 1/2, certified margin within a few ulps of analytic 2*sqrt(2)); surface_map_admission_certifies_rank_above_tau (plane patch, within a few ulps of analytic |S_u x S_v| = 2); degenerate_parameterization_refuses_named_case (quadratic Bezier whose derivative 2(2u-1) vanishes at u = 0.5; whole-domain admission refuses ParameterizationDegenerate; the per-region remedy splits off [0, 0.4] via truck-geometry cut and admits, while [0.4, 1.0] still containing the vanish refuses); non_compact_region_refuses_named_case (misordered/non-finite/outside regions refuse DomainNotCompact on both maps; inclusive edges admit); enclosure_contains_brute_force_samples (1000 curve + 1000 surface samples, surface subbox spanning both u-pieces); region_enclosure_contained_in_whole_domain_enclosure; bspline_curve_admission_matches_direct_bezier_admission (piece intervals + bit-equal enclosures on overlapping regions vs admitting each bezier_decomposition piece directly); bspline_surface_decomposition_covers_the_declared_domain (patch subboxes tile the unique-knot grid exactly, sorted adjacency equality in f64, PLUS direct tensor-commutation check: each patch grid's Bernstein evaluation agrees with the surface's own subs beyond ulp noise); rank_margin_lower_bound_bounded_by_brute_force_min (certified margin lower bound never overclaims the finite-difference min |C'| / |S_u x S_v|; the non-unit-width surface fixture locks the inverse-width derivative scaling); map_never_panics_and_tau_is_declared_not_inferred (every entry returns Result; admission takes PositiveFinite; H-1 comment-stripped source scan for unwrap/expect/panic).

deviations.derivation: The documented API admits only maps whose WHOLE-domain margin is above tau (admit_curve/admit_surface refuse otherwise), and the whole-domain margin is the MINIMUM over all pieces (D-region), so every sub-region of an admitted map has margin >= the whole-domain margin > tau: admit_curve_region / admit_surface_region cannot geometrically return ParameterizationDegenerate for an admitted map. The per-region remedy is therefore exercised as the packet's own remedy sentence prescribes -- 'admit a sub-region for locally-degenerate maps' -- by splitting the B-spline with truck-geometry's landed cut/decomposition into sub-curves (a new admission attempt over a subbox) and admitting those: degenerate_parameterization_refuses_named_case splits the vanish curve at 0.4, admits [0, 0.4], and still refuses [0.4, 1.0]. The ParameterizationDegenerate refusal vocabulary is exercised through the whole-domain admission path exactly as documented, and the region entry points still enforce it and the DomainNotCompact/EnclosureUnavailable refusals faithfully. No silent adaptation: this is the documented behavior implemented verbatim, recorded because a reader might otherwise expect the region remedy to return the refusal.

The D2 named composition computes only the certified LOWER bound of |C'| (resp. |S_u x S_v|): the sum over coordinates of the outward-rounded d_i^2, then the monotone square root. The returned CertifiedInterval therefore has lo = the certified lower bound and hi = +infinity (no upper-bound claim is made or implied). The admission decision compares only lo against the declared tau, matching the packet's 'certified lower bound against a declared threshold' pattern.

CertifiedInterval::mul on the square of a zero component returns [next_down(0), next_up(0)], a tiny negative sliver, so the accumulated lower bound of |C'|^2 can be a negative subnormal when the true lower bound is zero; the square root of a negative is NaN. The margin code clamps the certified lower bound to 0 before the (monotone) square root: sound because |C'|^2 >= 0 always, so replacing any negative lower bound by 0 keeps the bound valid. Without the clamp a genuinely degenerate map would refuse EnclosureUnavailable instead of ParameterizationDegenerate.

The maps expose three documented read-only structural accessors beyond the listed oracle methods -- CertifiedCurveMap::piece_intervals, CertifiedSurfaceMap::patch_boxes and CertifiedSurfaceMap::patch_grids -- because the load-bearing tests bspline_curve_admission_matches_direct_bezier_admission (piece table up to bookkeeping) and bspline_surface_decomposition_covers_the_declared_domain (patch subboxes tile the declared domain exactly) require them, and the tensor-commutation verification behind stop condition 2 needs the coefficient grids. Construction remains exclusively through admit_curve / admit_surface.

The rank margin is a bound on the Jacobian minor in the SOURCE parameter: |dC/dt| and |S_u x S_v|. The raw bernstein_derivative_1d / bernstein_derivative_2d output is the derivative w.r.t. the unit parameter, so each first-derivative coefficient vector/grid is scaled by the inverse piece width (1/(t_{i+1}-t_i), 1/(u_{i+1}-u_i), 1/(v_{j+1}-v_j)) before hulling -- a pure f64 coefficient transform of the same class as the derivative kernel itself, not additional interval algebra. This is required for correctness on non-unit-width pieces (the line curve's 1/2-width pieces and the u-width-2 surface fixture both exercise it; without it the margin would overclaim by the width factor). Stop condition 3 is NOT triggered: only the two named compositions are used.

The rank-margin containment test compares the certified lower bound against the minimum CENTRAL finite difference over a sample grid. For a constant-derivative line the certified bound sits within 1 ulp of the true 2*sqrt(2), while the finite-difference estimate can fall a few 1e-11 BELOW the true value because of catastrophic cancellation (~eps*|C|/h). The test therefore uses a coarse step (h = 0.05, exact for a line: zero truncation) and a 256*eps*brute_min estimation slack so the assertion enforces 'never overclaim the true minimum' without being defeated by the estimator's own rounding. The surface fixture (certified bound 1 well below the grid minimum ~1.0001) needs no slack.

Stop condition 1 (substrate movement vs anchors) NOT triggered: every anchor (A1-A7) measured after the work equals its expected value; hull.rs's kernels, bezier_decomposition's clamping semantics and PositiveFinite's API are exactly as read at dispatch. Stop condition 2 (tensor commutation) NOT triggered: bspline_surface_decomposition_covers_the_declared_domain directly evaluates every patch grid against the surface's own subs on an 8x8 sample per patch and finds only ulp noise; the row-wise-then-column-wise cut order commutes as pre-decided. Stop condition 3 (free-form interval arithmetic) NOT triggered: every enclosure goes through the landed hull kernels and the margin is exactly the two named compositions; the only arithmetic composed on top of the hull output is the packet's own fixed component rule through CertifiedInterval::mul/add (curve) and the three fixed cross-product expressions through mul/sub (surface). The returned CertifiedInterval hi endpoint is +infinity for margins (lower-bound-only representation, see RANK-MARGIN-IS-A-LOWER-BOUND-INTERVAL); enclosure intervals carry both certified bounds.
